facts.text: I am looking to organize a team project.
I attended a 3-day project management workshop last month.
I learned about Agile methodologies at the 3-day project management workshop.
I learned about the Scrum framework at the 3-day project management workshop.
I am considering using Jira for my team project.
I am considering using the free plan for Jira for now.
I am worried about the limitations of Jira's free plan.
I am interested in the differences between Jira's free and standard plans.
I am particularly interested in the custom fields feature in Jira's Standard plan.
I want to create a custom field in Jira to capture the estimated time required to complete each task.
I want to create a field in Jira to track the dependencies between tasks.
I want to use Jira's workflow editor to create custom workflows and automate tasks.

I want to use Jira's workflow editor conditions, validators, and post-functions to automate tasks and update custom fields.
